stem: According to the chapter, why is the legislature described as more than merely a law making body?
options: It drafts every bill without help from the bureaucracy.
It is the centre of the whole democratic political process.
It directly runs the day-to-day administration of the country.
It has the final say in interpreting the Constitution.
explanation: Correct option: (B). The chapter says law making is only one function; the legislature is the centre of all democratic political process and helps people hold representatives accountable. Drafting is done by the bureaucracy, administration is the executive's job, and interpreting the Constitution belongs to the judiciary.

stem: If the Rajya Sabha followed the US Senate model, what would happen in the case of Uttar Pradesh and Sikkim, as the chapter discusses?
